name: What should I prepare before a mobile home trim repair service?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before a mobile home trim repair service?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before an estimate or repair appointment, take note of all areas needing work, including doors, windows, ceilings, and baseboards. Clear furniture, curtains, and floor items at least three feet back from the walls to allow work space. If trim damage is near a plumbing fixture, window, or exterior wall, check if the area feels damp or soft and point it out to the contractor. Deciding in advance whether you want an exact match to existing factory trim or an upgrade to painted residential trim also speeds up planning.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear furniture away from walls, note all problem areas, check for damp spots near damaged trim, and decide whether you want factory-match strips or upgraded wood molding.
